# Portfolio repository metadata refresh — 2026-11-13

- **38/38 curated source repositories rechecked** against GitHub repository metadata and root `README.md` blob IDs.
- **27 repositories changed** since the previous committed scan baseline. The list below is a review queue, **not** a claim that every application feature or live demo has been revalidated.
- The repository metadata baseline was refreshed only after successful source reads. Curated project descriptions, status flags, feature claims, screenshots, GitHub pins, and demo URLs remain manually controlled.
- The three supposedly missing Traditional Chinese translations (InBody Simple Tracker, Boxmatch, Toy Robot) already exist under unquoted object keys. An automated catalogue integrity test now protects all 38 EN/ZH entries.
- The WanderStamp catalogue entry now links to its canonical `LEO0331/WanderStamp` repository. The existing project ID and public demo URL are intentionally unchanged.

## Follow-up and interpretation

The changes above were detected from current GitHub metadata and source README hashes. Push timestamps alone do not imply a new user-facing capability; the Portfolio is a curated showcase rather than a live mirror of every upstream data snapshot. No new projects have been discovered and no automatic feature claims were added.

The normal monthly scan is scheduled for the first day of each month; this in-session metadata refresh is a manually verified snapshot, not a GitHub Actions scan execution. A subsequent scheduled scan should compare from this new baseline. Keep this review queue until the relevant source changes have been editorially checked. The sync system still produces review proposals rather than editing descriptions or images automatically.
